G1_unambiguity.justification: The resonance condition clearly defines a bipartite graph through the requirement that every simple cycle has even length, and the requested configuration is unambiguously an independent set of exactly k modules.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary bounds, input meanings, structural guarantees, output requirements, and acceptance conditions are specified.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For undirected simple graphs, having every simple cycle even is equivalent to admitting a two-camp partition with every edge crossing between camps, so the feasible configurations and outputs are exactly the same.

G4_naturalness.justification: The sensor-array framing is coherent and readable, though the unexplained containment-zone detail is unnecessary and makes the statement slightly more contrived.
